conventions.node_names: <asset>__<part>; bj_* custom properties exported as extras

roles.variant: root of an era/intervention variant; id in bj_variant (registered in src/data/variants.json)
roles.level: one floor of a building (bj_level S/B/G/U/R, bj_building); pivot on that floor, hidden by the interior cutaway
roles.side: one facade of a floor (bj_side n/e/s/w); lowered when it faces the camera
roles.anchor: non-rendered point: doors, portal ends, targets, spawn/exit (bj_anchor)
roles.camera: security camera head, rotated at runtime (bj_camera)
roles.dynamic: part moved by the simulation: doors, van, lever, hatch lid, laser (bj_dynamic)
roles.character: skinned character mesh on the shared rig (bj_character)
roles.rig: the shared armature carrying the animation clips

conventions.transition_styles: bj_anim on variants: rise | fold | unfurl | pop | flatten | none
